messages:
June (Security): Quick advisory: we're doing a privilege-scope sweep of container runtimes and sidecars starting next week. Goal: eliminate CAP_SYS_ADMIN containers and reduce file-system mounts for customer-facing services. Please review your services by 2026-04-05. Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/privesc-sweep :rotating_light:
sec-bot: Advisory posted: privesc-sweep (v1) 026-03-22. Review deadline: 2026-04-05.
June (Security): What to check: 1) runtime capabilities (no CAP_SYS_ADMIN, CAP_NET_ADMIN unless approved) 2) hostPath mounts, privileged: true in pod specs 3) sidecars that run as root and access host namespaces.
Tom (Runtime): We'll add an admission webhook to reject new pods that request forbidden caps on 2026-04-06. Staging test on 2026-04-01.
Ivy (SRE): Does this affect infra-system namespaces (ingress, kube-system)?
June (Security): Infra-system namespaces are on the audit-only list. If your system needs privileges, file a runtime-exemption with justification by 2026-03-30. Exemptions require a plan to minimize scope and periodic review.
Oscar (Platform): Action steps for teams: run runtime-scan --org=your-team to list offending manifests; we've added a lint rule to infra-lint to fail CI on forbidden caps.
Mira (Product): Calling out mobile sync: we use a native sidecar for db-shim that mounts /var/cache. Will this be flagged?
June (Security): Yes, that mount will show up. If the sidecar cannot run without it, request an exemption and include a migration plan to use an ephemeral volume or CSI driver.
Tom (Runtime): Here's a quick fix pattern: set securityContext.capabilities.drop = ["ALL"] and then add only required caps via add if absolutely needed. Example snippet:
```
securityContext:
  capabilities:
    drop: ["ALL"]
    add: ["NET_BIND_SERVICE"]
  runAsNonRoot: true
```
Ivy (SRE): Will this require re-deploy windows nodes? Some services need host-network for networking tests.
June (Security): HostNetwork is not banned globally but will be restricted to specific clusters and approved owners. File requests early.
sec-bot: Reminder: runtime sweep office hours 2026-03-28 17:00 UTC. Zoom in #eng-all.
Oscar (Platform): We'll produce a remediation playbook and a small migration job that can replace hostPath with emptyDir+init-copy where feasible. ETA docs: 2026-03-24.
Mira (Product): We'll prioritize user-facing services. Any enforcement date yet?
June (Security): Enforcement (reject new non-exempt pods) targeted for 2026-04-12 after a staged rollout. Please ack when you run the scan.
Ivy (SRE): Running scan now. Will comment back with inventory link.
Tom (Runtime): Noted. We'll ensure webhook logs include the pod name and offending field for quick triage.
June (Security): Thanks all. If you hit blockers, ping me or join the office hours. Please avoid lengthy threads here 1 1 ack with short status updates.
